title: TRICARE Prime Enrollment Fee Schedule
content:
**TRICARE Prime** enrollment fees are owed only by tiers that are not fee-exempt, are set per calendar plan year, and are billed once per sponsor family to the fee-bearing enrollment - the sponsor's own enrollment when the sponsor is enrolled in Prime, otherwise the enrollment of the eldest enrolled family member.

## Annual fees by tier

| Tier | Fee-exempt | Annual fee, individual (USD per plan year) | Annual fee, family (USD per plan year) | Installment due |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| TRICARE Prime Active Duty Service Member | yes | 0.00 | 0.00 | not applicable |
| TRICARE Prime Remote Active Duty Service Member | yes | 0.00 | 0.00 | not applicable |
| TRICARE Prime Active Duty Family Member | yes | 0.00 | 0.00 | not applicable |
| TRICARE Prime Remote Active Duty Family Member | yes | 0.00 | 0.00 | not applicable |
| TRICARE Prime Transitional Survivor | yes | 0.00 | 0.00 | not applicable |
| TRICARE Prime Retiree Group A | no | 390.12 | 780.24 | first day of the installment period |
| TRICARE Prime Retiree Group B | no | 484.68 | 969.36 | first day of the installment period |

Each tier applies its own fee-exempt status and its own individual and family figures from this table.

## Clauses

1. The family owes the individual annual fee while exactly one family member is enrolled in Prime and the family annual fee while two or more are; family members enrolled in TRICARE Select are billed separately under TRICARE Select and do not count toward the Prime family.
2. An annual installment is the full annual fee, a quarterly installment is one quarter of it (the annual fee divided by 4) and a monthly installment is one twelfth of it (the annual fee divided by 12), each rounded to the cent.
3. A first installment is charged together with the application.
4. Installments are charged only on a fee-bearing enrollment whose status is applied or active.
5. A fee-bearing enrollment is activated only after its first installment charge has a payment posted against it. A fee-exempt tier's enrollment is activated without any installment.
6. When a second family member enrolls the family moves from the individual to the family fee from the next installment period, and when the family drops to one enrolled member it moves back to the individual fee from the next installment period.

The enrollment's fee balance owed rises with installment charges and with refunds of credit balances, and falls with payments and proration credits; a negative balance is a credit owed to the beneficiary. Clause 4 is read from the enrollment's own record (its status and whether it is the fee-bearing enrollment); clause 5 is read from the enrollment's own fee account.

## Retired clauses

The following clauses of this schedule are **no longer in force**; they have been superseded by the current basis and are not applied:

- "Installments cover calendar quarters (January, April, July, October) or calendar months and are due on the first day of the period they cover."
- "For an enrollment that starts mid-period, the first installment covers the months from the month containing the enrollment effective date (counted as a whole month) to the end of that installment period and equals one twelfth of the annual fee for each of those months."

The fee figures in the table above remain valid.

## Installment figures (computed from the table)

| Tier and fee | Annual installment | Quarterly installment | Monthly installment |
|---|---|---|---|
| Retiree Group A, individual | 390.12 | 97.53 | 32.51 |
| Retiree Group A, family | 780.24 | 195.06 | 65.02 |
| Retiree Group B, individual | 484.68 | 121.17 | 40.39 |
| Retiree Group B, family | 969.36 | 242.34 | 80.78 |

## Basis questions

**Does a family with one Prime member and two TRICARE Select members owe the Prime family fee?** No. Select members do not count toward the Prime family, so exactly one family member is enrolled in Prime and the individual fee applies.

**Can an application for a TRICARE Prime Retiree Group B enrollment be activated while its first installment charge has no payment posted against it?** No; activation follows a payment posted against that first installment charge.

superseded_clauses: Installments cover calendar quarters (January, April, July, October) or calendar months and are due on the first day of the period they cover.

For an enrollment that starts mid-period, the first installment covers the months from the month containing the enrollment effective date (counted as a whole month) to the end of that installment period and equals one twelfth of the annual fee for each of those months.
